dedupe_keys.name: dreal nouvelle aquitaine flood hazard datasets

description: DREAL Nouvelle Aquitaine: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Nouvelle Aquitaine. Coverage: DREAL Nouvelle Aquitaine. The listing groups 214 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : Atlas des zones inondables de la Garonne - Limite; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Dax - Zones de sur-aléa provoqué par la ru; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Libourne (aléa ) - Zones inondables, Direc; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Bordeaux (aléa ) - Zones inondables, Direc. Formats seen: MAPINFO TAB, ZIP, SHAPE, WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
